note: No target at all — the oneOf requires exactly one of `sessionId`, `all` and `subject`.
`subject` and `sessionId` together — mutually exclusive. A producer cannot scope a single-session revoke to a subject; the session names its own subject.
`subject` and `all` together — mutually exclusive, and ambiguous about whose sessions are meant.
`subject` must be a DID — a bare handle would let the consumer guess which party is meant.
